text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered - latency-slo-burn (auto-page)
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.internal/r/INC-4321 - p99 latency > 2.5s for 6m across inference-hosting in us-west-2

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: p95=1.12s, p99=3.82s, error_rate=0.25% (normal), QPS=650 -> baseline 420
Routes impacted: /v1/generate (75% of affected), /v1/chat/stream (20%).
Suspected cause: sudden traffic spike + increased tail latency on gpu-pool-1 kernels. No 5xx spike observed.

PagerDuty: Incident created: INC-4321 (Severity: P2)

alex: Acked. I'm on call and taking lead. grabbing current autoscaler + pool health.

sam: on it. checking autoscaler metrics now. looks like effective replica count stayed at 6, queue depth increased. can we bump pool?

jordan: tagging in. Runtime team saw a sudden increase in KV cache misses correlated with seq-len jump for a subset of requests from acme-corp. Could be a prompt change or clients sending large context.

alex: good call. @maria do we have any customer comms? Is acme-corp running a big job?

maria: reaching out to acct team now. I'm pinging acme slack and CS. will update.

sam: let's try quick capacity scale + temporary routing rule to offload big requests. I can scale gpu-pool-1 to 10 replicas. ETA ~2m for pods to register.

alex: go for it. runbook step: scale pool, monitor p99. if no improvement, failover heavy routes to dedicated-fallback cluster.

sam: running: ```rdctl cluster scale --pool gpu-pool-1 --replicas 10```
sam: pods coming up, nodes 7/10 ready, 9/10 ready, 10/10 ready. routing updates in progress.

incident-bot: Update: autoscaler override applied by sam (manual scale).

sam: initial improvement visible: p95 -> 920ms, p99 -> 2.1s. still above p99 target but trending down.

jordan: while scaling, I'm toggling a kernel fallback for long-sequence paths to reduce tail-latency variance. Pushing `runtime-config` change to route requests with seq_len>1024 to qos=low path using optimized kernels.

jordan: config diff:`
```json
{"routing": {"seq_len_threshold": 1024, "long_seq_path": "qos-low"}}
```

jordan: applied. rolling forward to 50% of nodes, will ramp to 100% if stable.

alex: nice. monitoring. Any customer-facing errors?

maria: acme acknowledged a short spike but no dropped requests. CS reports some increased latencies for their batch job. they're throttling for now.

sam: p99 back to 1.9s and still falling. queue depth normalized. looks like scale + kernel fallback helped.

PagerDuty: Note: Incident INC-4321 acknowledged by alex at 1768504350.

alex: good progress. leaving a quick mitigation checklist: scale pool + kernel fallback + route heavy seq to dedicated-fallback. also add temporary rate-limit on /v1/generate per-tenant to protect SLOs.

jordan: I'll prepare a map for permanent fix: KV cache tuning + improved prefix caching for long prompts. filing follow-up ticket: INF-2982.

maria: Acme confirmed degraded UX but no permanent failures. CS will follow up with a note. recommend no external status page update yet.

clara: taking over monitoring while alex steps off for handoff in 10m. if p99 creeps back above 2.5s, escalate to oncall-1 and open dedicated-fallback.

alex: handing to clara. notes: autoscaler override still active, cluster at 10 replicas, runtime kernel fallback at 100% rollout for long seq. keep an eye on tail latency and queue depth.

clara: ack. I've got it. adding quick commands to runbook for tomorrow's follow-up: ```rdctl cluster describe gpu-pool-1 --metrics``` and ```rdctl route update --target dedicated-fallback --route '/v1/generate' --match 'tenant:acme-corp'```

sam: removing manual override scheduled: will set autoscaler back to baseline once stable for 15m. scheduling: revert at 1768505400 unless manual hold.

incident-bot: Update: manual override removed by sam at 1768505200 (autoscaler control returned to automated).

alex: quick postmortem notes for handoff: root cause probable combination of abrupt client-side prompt size increase (acme batch) + insufficient cache priming for long sequences -> caused kernel tail regressions under sustained QPS. Mitigations that worked: scale, kernel routing fallback, short term tenant throttling.

maria: will coordinate customer follow-up and request their prompt artifacts for repro.

clara: tagging infra-team for follow-up on resource footprints and cost impact. @jordan will you own KV cache tuning?

jordan: yes, I'll take INF-2982. aiming for a fix + test in next sprint.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll write the incident summary and link infra ticket. handing complete.

clara: closing loop for now. monitoring 30m post-handoff then we'll downgrade incident if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INC-4321 status: stabilizing. last metrics at 1768506121 -> p95=740ms, p99=1.05s, error_rate=0.18%

clara: final note before I step back: follow-ups - INF-2982 (KV cache), DOC-1127 (runbook update for long-seq routing), COST-731 (cost review for manual scale). I'll file the slash commands and link tickets later.

maria: thanks team. CS will send a short customer note to Acme after we confirm repro.

alex: nice mitigation. closing active page. :thumbsup:
